head_title: Nyves - bring back Hyves profiles with Nostr

They're the creators of Ditto, MKStack, Shakespeare, and other innovative platforms that are reshaping how people connect and communicate on the internet.

hyves-back-online.title: Hyves back as a social platform, thousands of visitors for Nyves
hyves-back-online.description: On Tuesday 22 September, Hyves was brought back online as a social platform by Mediahuis. People are now searching for Hyves en masse, and Nyves is being found by thousands of people.

follow-the-money.title: Nyves mentioned by Follow The Money
follow-the-money.description: Follow The Money published an article titled "Hyves does run on American tech, contrary to what owner De Telegraaf claims".

proprivacy-podcast.title: Nyves mentioned in the ProPrivacy podcast
proprivacy-podcast.description: Hyves is discussed in this ProPrivacy podcast episode from minute 22. A little later, at minute 36, it is also about Nyves and how we can set up social media in an alternative way thanks to the open nostr protocol.

aos-collective-donation.title: And Other Stuff Collective donates $15,000 to Nyves
aos-collective-donation.description: Nyves has received a $15,0000 donation from the AOS Collective via OpenCollective.

angry-nerds-podcast.title: Nyves is featured again in the Angry Nerds podcast
angry-nerds-podcast.description: The AngryNerds discuss Hyves and conclude that building up profiles for their own Mediahuis advertising business is the only goal. And that you should not confuse it with Nyves! "They are currently indexing 8 million old Hyves accounts for web archive restores. And Nyves is based on nostr."

defs.text: means websites, apps, relays, media storage, APIs and other systems owned or controlled by Nyves.
means any media referenced within a Nostr event that is stored on third-party infrastructure.
means the decentralized protocol known as "Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays", which enables users to publish, retrieve and verify content using cryptographic keypairs and signed messages.

means a cryptographically signed data object published using the Nostr protocol. Once broadcast, Nostr events may be stored or replicated across multiple independent relays, including relays Nyves does not own or control.

means the cryptographic public/private keypair used to create, sign and authenticate Nostr events. The public key functions as a user identifier and the private key is required to sign events and prove authorship.

means any independently operated server implementing the Nostr protocol for receiving, storing, indexing or redistributing Nostr events. Unless expressly stated otherwise, relays are not operated by Nyves.

means any Nostr event, media, metadata, username, profile information or other material submitted, published, uploaded, linked or otherwise made available by a user through the Service, whether hosted by Nyves or externally.
means historical material originating from a legacy platform (such as Hyves) that has been restored, converted into Nostr events, or indexed by Nyves.

The Service may index, display, surface, cache, transmit or host Nostr events and related media, and may display or link to externally hosted content. Unless expressly stated otherwise, Nyves does not own or control independent relays, third-party storage providers, archives or external hosts.

Any historical or legacy content surfaced through the Service may include both user-submitted material and content accessed from external archival or legacy sources, and is not content created, owned or endorsed by Nyves.
